title: Fix: example sha256 value inconsistent with example size
description: The upload response example (lines 150-154) shows sha256 '9f86d081...' which is the SHA-256 of the 4-byte ASCII string 'test', but size is 48291. Internally inconsistent examples in RFCs cause reviewer confusion. Either make the values consistent (pick a real sha256/size pair) or add a note that values are illustrative only.
close_reason: Added '(field values are illustrative)' to example caption at line 146.
